okr.objective: Corotiacus is a British god honored at Suffolk.
key_results: The Celts honored Corotiacus at Suffolk.
The invading Romans connected Corotiacus with their war god Mars.
Little else is known about Corotiacus.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

text: Corotiacus ranks among the gods of Celtic Britain. Followers venerated him in the Suffolk region. Rome's invading forces matched him with Mars, their own deity of war. Hardly anything else of his cult is recorded.
